R_CoreAcademy.text: Core Worlds Rex Fleet Academy environment. Mature Fleet institutional culture: blue, white, and gold signal stewardship and authority; spaces are functional, inhabited, and built on post-Shattering memory without turning every room into a shrine.

R_PublicCorridor.text: Core-adjacent public corridor network maintained through BHA verification. Green indicates verified low-tension travel volume; red means unsafe or sensor-failed/unverified. The beacon line marks the center of a verified volume, not a physical rail or wall.
